## Summary

<!-- What does this change do, in one or two sentences? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor (no behavior change)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tooling / CI

## Checklist

- [ ] `flutter analyze` passes
- [ ] `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed .` passes
- [ ] `flutter test` passes
- [ ] `./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest` passes (android/)
- [ ] Parser or classifier behavior changes are covered by JVM tests
- [ ] No keys, tokens or personal data are committed
